limit: Frozen stills only: no evidence of motion, GPU cost, load stalls or feel.

look.scope: Local preview; not the game default
look.label: Current

exposure.meaning: Trim multiplies the shared GPU meter. meterGain is sampled once on lock, not a portable lighting calibration.

graphics.label: Resolution
graphics.skips: Lower scale shades fewer scene pixels; output post remains full canvas size.
graphics.hitch: Resizing reallocates render targets.

graphics.label: Frame limit
graphics.skips: Skips scene/output render calls; gameplay, physics, FFT and water queries keep their callback cadence.

graphics.label: Scene MSAA
graphics.skips: Off uses one scene sample instead of four; caustics MSAA is independent.
graphics.hitch: Reload builds sample-count pipelines behind loading. Live sample changes invalidate cached depth copies and bind groups.

graphics.label: Sun shadows
graphics.skips: Removes sun shadow rendering and receiver shadow sampling; leaves sun light and day clock intact.
graphics.hitch: Changing the light shadow key builds material pipelines on first use.

graphics.label: Point lights
graphics.skips: Skips source selection and excludes both pool lights from lit draws; source glows stay visible.
graphics.hitch: Changing light membership can compile material variants on first use.

graphics.label: Caustics producer
graphics.skips: Clears to flat illumination once, then skips producer draws and mip work; receiver sampling remains.

graphics.label: Underwater shafts
graphics.skips: Skips the shaft target update and four-tap composite; water boundary and fog remain.
graphics.hitch: If disabled at startup, its first enabled draw can compile the deferred shaft pipeline.

graphics.label: Wet lens droplets
graphics.skips: Branches around droplet evaluation/distortion. Shared 64×36 boundary/depth compute remains.

graphics.label: Underwater snow
graphics.skips: Skips the 6000-sprite draw and per-frame projection update.

graphics.label: Water bloom
graphics.skips: Bypasses the entire bloom chain; allocated targets are retained until water disposal.
graphics.hitch: First enable builds optional targets and pipelines on the next draw; it can hitch.

graphics.label: Exposure meter
graphics.cost: two meter passes and history copy
graphics.skips: Skips metering, adaptation and history copy; holds the last exposure texture.

graphics.label: Shore spray
graphics.skips: Skips shore/rock emitter preparation, scans and emissions. Impact cues remain; existing drops drain.
graphics.hitch: Enabling after off-at-start can build the shore emitter list on its first update.

graphics.label: Buddy diffuse ramp
graphics.cost: Direct diffuse only on Buddy and carried logs; no new draws or buffers.
graphics.skips: Current restores the original material objects and lighting graph.
graphics.hitch: First enable compiles the selected ramp. Warm before measuring.

graphics.label: Buddy ramp shape
graphics.cost: Soft shoulder or unmistakable two-band direct diffuse.
graphics.skips: Only used when Buddy diffuse ramp is on.

notFrozen: Server/socket traffic and asset promises are not paused; use an isolated settled beat. Pixel probes fail on visible drift.
Temporal accumulation effects must supply their own freeze adapter; repeat probes reject history drift.
